scenes.heading: How taxes generally work for trading activity

sents.d: How taxes generally work for trading activity
Tax treatment varies a lot by country and by how the activity is classified.
Tax treatment of trading profits varies significantly by country, and sometimes by how frequently you trade or whether it's classified as investment income versus business income.

Keeping detailed records of every trade — dates, amounts, fees — throughout the year makes tax time significantly less stressful than trying to reconstruct a year of activity from memory or scattered statements afterward.
This is general education only, not tax advice — a licensed accountant or tax professional familiar with trading activity in your specific country can give guidance accurate to your situation.

take: Record every trade and get local tax advice.
